tests.title: parses declared defaults, shorthand, aliases, booleans and colours into frozen settings
prepares CCIR colours and resolves config_input geometry with the native iteration
draws boxes and grids into owned tight planes from padded input without mutating it
rejects unsupported layouts, budgets, malformed storage, time bases and cancellation explicitly
plans drawbox and drawgrid on every flagged path and refuses size-dependent geometry before output
runs against the reference build of the pinned commit without x86 assembly
matches native linear drawbox and drawgrid bytes for integer colours across formats, sizes, crossing and outside boxes and patterns
matches native translucent drawbox and drawgrid blending on linear chains and the CLI paths (linux-x64 unfused double and float)
matches native drawbox and drawgrid rawvideo and framecrc through linear, graph, actor and timed CLI execution with and without -ss/-t
matches native replayed drawbox and drawgrid branches and joins frame by frame
refuses native errors with native status and the scoped-out forms native runs, before opening outputs on every path
negotiates every accepted source as native does for drawbox and drawgrid and runs each pick on every path

details: 1560 linear rawvideo byte comparisons (3 frames each): 10 stored formats x 6 sizes (1x1 2x2 5x3 7x5 8x6 17x9) x 26 integer-colour drawbox/drawgrid filters
1000 linux-x64-gated translucent comparisons: 360 linear (10 formats x 6 sizes x 6 filters) and 640 CLI (10 formats x 7x5 x 4 filters x rawvideo/framecrc x 2 time scopes x 4 executions)

1920 CLI byte comparisons: 10 formats x 7x5/17x9 x 6 filters x rawvideo/framecrc x without/with -ss 0.04 -t 0.05 x media -vf, media -filter_complex, timed activation actors, timed pull executor; native default threads equal -filter_threads 1 in every case
17 native status checks (7 native EINVAL errors at 256-EINVAL, 10 forms native runs) with 17 linear and 68 CLI refusals before output
146 per-source negotiation checks (2 filters x 73): all 17 sources pick stored formats (gray and gbrp -> rgb24) and run byte-exact on five paths

unsupported: expressions reading sar or dar (frames carry no sample aspect ratio on every path)
expression calls to sin cos tan asin acos atan atan2 sinh cosh tanh exp pow gauss squish random randomi time print lerp while taylor root
expression results outside int or NaN in the final pass (NaN fails as natively), drawbox x+w / y+h and drawgrid offset int overflow
reads of fill after an undefined (int) conversion of x or y in the same pass (platform-dependent natively), e.g. y=ih-h:h=fill-1
random/bikeshed colours and NaN or platform-dependent alphas
yuv411p yuv410p yuv440p yuvj440p yuva422p yuva444p 0rgb 0bgr rgb0 bgr0 (no frame storage; negotiators refuse by name, but no accepted source picks them)

notes: Status partial: sar and dar expression variables (in the specified scope) are refused because VideoFrameData carries no sample aspect ratio and descriptor geometry() does not receive one on every path; supporting them needs a shared frame or descriptor change (not requested, not made). Everything else in scope is implemented and native-compared.
Expressions are evaluated under both linux-x64 and darwin-arm64 expression profiles and refused if the integer geometry differs, so no profile is selected inside the operator.
EdgeFFmpeg exits 1 for the native EINVAL configuration errors (native 234 on Linux); the CLI exit-status mapping is outside the owned files, so only refusal and no output are asserted.
The translucent gate is a precaution taken from the determinism notes; no macOS run was possible in this sandbox.

Setup durations: Node 24.22.3 tarball install ~10s (sandbox had Node 22.23.5, bootstrap requires 24+), bootstrap (npm 9.3s, submodule 6.2s, reference build) 200s, baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+registry test 60s. Differential file runs in ~35s with --maxWorkers=1 on 4 vCPUs.
Environment: bootstrap reports the sandbox reference differs from the pinned linux-x64 binary sha (expected for an unpinned sandbox build).
